# Development roadmap

Completed: rational Runge, prescribed poles, polynomial Runge, and actual-domain
interfaces; smooth compact-support Cauchy–Pompeiu and its uniform estimates;
neighbourhood-holomorphic Arakelian approximation. The original targets and
56 selected axiom reports are checked.

Next mathematics: verify the bounded-holes condition for the strip configurations
in the Eremenko counterexample application. The full continuous-on-the-set
Arakelian theorem and equivalence with the sphere-complement condition are
separate later goals.

Preparation for Mathlib: review theorem statements and local-domain interfaces;
identify reusable cutoff, integral, uniform-closure, and pole-moving lemmas;
refactor large proofs and broad imports; add documentation; discuss interfaces
with relevant maintainers before arranging incremental submissions.

Current compilation does not establish readiness for inclusion in Mathlib.
